name: Clavileño — "It gains QUOTED" after "becomes a Demon"; "that isn't a X" is not a type removal
notes: Fired trigger: the quoted grant in the second sentence was dropped because its match was measured from the line start, inside the add-type match. "Vampire that isn't a Demon" was also read as a board-wide "isn't a Demon" type removal (same on Rakdos, the Showstopper; Heliod, the Radiant Dawn; Wrathful Raptors).

$includes: When this creature dies, draw a card and create a tapped 4/3 white and black Vampire Demon creature token with flying.
